name: ForTheRecord Notification-to-Email Bridge
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed self-hosted notification gateway that accepts SMTP, ntfy, Apprise, Shoutrrr, cURL and JSON webhook inputs and stores notifications in an existing Gmail or IMAP inbox; no software usage quota or expiry documented.
watch_out: Requires an existing Gmail/IMAP account and your own host or container. Gmail mode requires Google Cloud OAuth client configuration and Gmail API access; provider limits, account policies and hosting costs still apply. Distinct from Mailrise, which forwards SMTP messages to Apprise notification destinations.
